name: LinguaLens
source_reference: direct-authored side-caret selection mark from semantic-icon-design.json
brief: LinguaLens selection mark: vivid indigo stage, empty 3.5:1 word highlight, two white iOS-style handles. Vertical carets sit on the left and right edges of the rectangle. Start knob sits fully above the top-left; end knob sits fully below the bottom-right.

semantic_review.basis: original geometric mark with no external brand or font source; geometry authored from the side-caret selection contract
semantic_review.notes: Empty rounded selection bar plus two disconnected handle groups. Carets are full-height side stems. Handles are filled circle-plus-rect, not strokes. No letters.

source_analysis.fidelity_target: preserve an empty 3.5:1 word-height selection bar with diagonally paired iOS handles whose vertical carets sit on the left and right edges
must_preserve: empty selection interior with no letters
left caret centered on the bar's left edge
right caret centered on the bar's right edge
start handle fully above the top-left
end handle fully below the bottom-right
must_not_add: carets attached to the top or bottom edges
camera brackets, magnifier, translator arrows, or sparkles
bevel, glow, shadow, highlight, or glass shine
boolean hole, mask, clipPath, stroke, or opacity
rounded app mask in imported foreground assets
